labels.title: Labels

labels.nothingSelectedHint: Pick at least one item to print labels for

labels.encodingNote: Internal barcodes encode identifiers that already exist — SKU, lot number, location code — as Code 128. Nothing is invented.

labels.lotNote: Lot labels are the primary scan target: one per drum or handling unit.
labels.noBarcodeShelf: No barcode – use a shelf label
labels.qcBoxNote: Labels print identity plus a blank QC block to complete by pen (tick, inspector, date). Current QC status comes from scanning, never from the label.

qc.title: QC
qc.subtitle: Decide lot QC results, and write off lots that failed

qc.confirmPass: Confirm this lot passed QC — it becomes available everywhere
qc.confirmScrap: Write off everything remaining of this lot
qc.effectPass: A passed lot becomes issuable immediately, everywhere — including stock already put away
qc.effectFail: A failed lot cannot be issued or delivered from anywhere, but its quantity stays visible
qc.notAllowedToScrap: You need permission to dispose of stock that has not passed QC
qc.notAllowedToPost: You do not have permission to post adjustments
qc.nothingToScrap: No stock left to write off
qc.lotPassed: This lot has passed QC — use a normal stock adjustment instead
qc.scrapAwaitingApproval: Write-off raised. Waiting for a warehouse manager to approve.
qc.scrapNeedsApproval: A warehouse manager must approve this. The lot stays unissuable while it waits.
qc.notAllowedToRaise: You do not have permission to create adjustments

adjustments.title: Stock adjustment
adjustments.subtitle: Corrections to the record
adjustments.newSubtitle: Correct the record with a new movement
adjustments.reasonHint: Fixed for the whole document — one adjustment, one explanation
adjustments.disposalNeedsQc: This reason removes stock permanently. If any lot has not passed QC, only the QC role can post it.
adjustments.unpassedDisposalWarning: This adjustment disposes of stock that has not passed QC, so it needs the QC role to post — a manager cannot.
adjustments.reasonNeedsDirection: This reason code has no direction set, so the system cannot tell which way stock moves. Fix the reason code in master data.
adjustments.scanBinToCount: Scan the bin you are counting
adjustments.scanBinFound: Scan the bin where you found it
adjustments.countedNotLower: To reduce stock, the counted quantity must be below {qty}. Use a found-stock reason to add.
adjustments.lotNoHint: As printed on the drum. Created if the system does not know it, and left awaiting QC.
adjustments.serialNotSupported: Found serial-tracked stock needs a receipt, not an adjustment — a serial with no arrival history cannot be traced.
adjustments.notesHint: What happened. This is the part an auditor reads.
adjustments.youMayApproveLater: You may approve this yourself on the document, but a second person is the point.
adjustments.qtyPositive: Quantity must be more than zero
adjustments.lotRequired: A lot number is required for this product
adjustments.notABin: That is not a bin label
adjustments.noReasons: No adjustment reason codes exist yet. Add them under Master data first — without them an adjustment cannot say why stock changed.
adjustments.emptyHint: Raise one to correct a balance.
adjustments.decreaseNeedsQc: This reason removes stock. If any lot has not passed QC, only the QC role can post it — a manager cannot.

import.title: Import item master
import.subtitle: From an AccCloud product export (CSV)
import.readFileHint: AccCloud product export, CSV. Nothing changes until you commit.
import.groupsIntro: {file} — {rows} rows. Tick the groups that are warehouse stock.
import.groupsHint: Services, fixed assets and transport are unticked by default: they are real AccCloud records but they never sit on a shelf.
import.name: Name
import.truncated: Showing {shown} of {total} rows. Errors and updates are listed first.
import.errorsWillBeSkipped: Rows with errors will be left out and stay visible on this batch. Nothing is silently dropped.
import.uomFrozen: {count} rows would change the base unit of a product that already has stock movements. Refused: every past quantity is recorded in the old unit and cannot be converted retrospectively. Fix the unit in AccCloud, or retire the SKU and create a new one.
import.unknownUoms: Unrecognised units in this file: {list}. Add them to the UOM mapping before importing — guessing a unit silently changes every quantity that follows.
import.alreadyImported: This exact file has been committed before (matched on content, not filename). Re-importing will update rather than duplicate, but check that you meant to.
import.missingColumns: The file is missing required columns
import.alreadyCommitted: This batch has already been committed
import.nothingToApply: Nothing to apply — every row was excluded or errored
